issues.legal_issue: A party may challenge the legality of a compromise recorded under Order 23, Rule 3 of the Code of Civil Procedure through a recall application, including after the compromise decree has been passed.

Restoration or recall is the statutory remedy for an aggrieved party challenging a compromise decree, and it cannot be barred by an order recording the compromise that denies liberty to seek restoration.
The court that recorded a compromise must determine its legality when challenged, including whether alleged fraud rendered the agreement voidable.
